BetaWorkspaceUpdateParams.description: Partial update — omitted fields are unchanged.

data_residency.description: Data residency configuration for the workspace.

display_color.description: Hex color code representing the Workspace in the Anthropic Console.
display_color.title: Display Color

external_key_id.description:
ID of the customer-managed encryption key (CMEK) configuration to use for this
Workspace. Setting this field requires CMEK to be enabled for your
organization. When set, data stored for this Workspace is encrypted with the
referenced key. Create key configurations with the External Keys API. On
Claude Platform on AWS the value for an AWS KMS key is the key's ARN, and your
organization's own key must be a single-Region key in the same Region as the
Workspace. If that key is outside the Workspace's AWS account, it can be attached
only by updating an active Workspace. On that platform the key is validated
against this Workspace when it is attached, so a key-policy problem is reported
as an error on this request. This field is write-once: once a key is attached to
a Workspace it cannot be detached or replaced. To rotate key material, rotate
the underlying key on your cloud KMS; the `external_key_id` stays the same.
external_key_id.title: External Key Id

inference_data_privacy.description: Changes to where the Workspace's retained inference data and transcript copies go, and to whether Anthropic's human review applies. Requires the `efs-2026-10-01` `anthropic-beta` value. An omitted member is unchanged. Cannot be null. An Admin API key can't set this field, because it doesn't belong to a user or a service account. Use an API key that belongs to one, or an OAuth token.

tags.description: User-defined tags as string key-value pairs. Keys may not begin with `anthropic`.
tags.title: Tags

user_profile_id.description: ID of a user profile to attach to the Workspace. Every inference request through the Workspace must then name this user profile; the API rejects a request that names none or a different one. Once set, it can't be replaced or removed (sending the same ID again changes nothing); only deleting the user profile clears it. It can't be set on a Workspace whose External Key isn't bound to this user profile. The default Workspace can't have a user profile.
user_profile_id.title: User Profile Id

archived_at.description: RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the Workspace was archived, or `null` if the Workspace is not archived.
archived_at.title: Archived At

compartment_id.description:
Identifier for this Workspace's encryption compartment. When you configure an
AWS KMS customer-managed encryption key (CMEK) that isn't bound to a user
profile, reference this value in your KMS key-policy condition so the key is
scoped to this compartment. On GCP and Azure, Anthropic enforces the compartment
binding automatically; you do not need to reference this value in your key
configuration. See the CMEK integration guide for the required key
configuration; unless your organization is on Claude Platform on AWS, it
includes a separate value used during key validation. On Claude Platform on AWS
there is no separate validation value: your organization's own key is validated
against this Workspace's own value when it is attached, so if its key policy
uses the compartment condition, add this value to it before attaching the key.
compartment_id.title: Compartment Id

created_at.description: RFC 3339 datetime string indicating when the Workspace was created.

BetaExternalStorageNotAvailableErrorDeta.description: External Storage isn't available for this Workspace, so only `internal` storage is accepted. The error's `message` says why.
BetaExternalStorageNotAvailableErrorDeta.title: ExternalStorageNotAvailableErrorDetails

BetaGrantRequiredErrorDetails.description: Anthropic has not approved External Storage for the organization, for the Workspace or, for storage bound to a user profile, for that user profile. Contact your Anthropic account team.
BetaGrantRequiredErrorDetails.title: GrantRequiredErrorDetails

BetaHumanReviewNotAvailableErrorDetails.description: Human review can't be set as requested on this Workspace, so the request changed nothing. The error's `message` says what to do instead.
BetaHumanReviewNotAvailableErrorDetails.title: HumanReviewNotAvailableErrorDetails

BetaHumanReviewOnWithExternalStorageErro.description: The request would leave the Workspace with `inference_data_privacy.safeguards_storage` set to External Storage and `inference_data_privacy.human_review` enabled. Anthropic doesn't offer human review of data in a customer's own storage. Set `human_review` to `disabled`, or `safeguards_storage` to `internal`.
BetaHumanReviewOnWithExternalStorageErro.title: HumanReviewOnWithExternalStorageErrorDetails

BetaInvalidStorageArnErrorDetails.description: On Claude Platform on AWS, the External Storage ID in the request is neither a bucket ARN nor an `estrg_` ID, or is the `estrg_` ID of AWS storage. Name AWS storage by its bucket ARN, `arn:<partition>:s3:::<bucket_name>`, which responses return as its `id`.
BetaInvalidStorageArnErrorDetails.title: InvalidStorageArnErrorDetails

BetaKeyProfileMismatchErrorDetails.description: After this request, the External Key and the Workspace would not have the same user profile. A key and its Workspace must have the same user profile, or both have none.
BetaKeyProfileMismatchErrorDetails.title: KeyProfileMismatchErrorDetails

BetaOrganizationNotEligibleErrorDetails.description: The feature isn't offered to this organization. The error's `message` names the kind of organization or, when it names none, says to contact your Anthropic account team.
BetaOrganizationNotEligibleErrorDetails.title: OrganizationNotEligibleErrorDetails

BetaStorageAttachLimitReachedErrorDetail.title: StorageAttachLimitReachedErrorDetails

BetaStorageNotAttachableErrorDetails.description: This External Storage can't be attached to the setting named in `field`. The error's `message` says why.
BetaStorageNotAttachableErrorDetails.title: StorageNotAttachableErrorDetails

BetaStorageProfileMismatchErrorDetails.description: The Workspace's storage and its user profile don't match: the Workspace and its storage must have the same user profile, or both have none.

BetaInferenceDataPrivacyUpdateParams.description:
Changes to where the Workspace's retained inference data and transcript
copies go, and to whether Anthropic's human review applies. An omitted member
is unchanged; a member cannot be null.

human_review.description: Whether Anthropic's human review applies to the Workspace from now on. `disabled` needs Anthropic's approval. When omitted, unchanged. Cannot be null.

safeguards_storage.description: Where the data Anthropic's safeguards systems retain for the Workspace goes once the change takes effect. `external` sends it to the External Storage that `external_storage_id` names. `internal` means no External Storage: it goes to Anthropic's storage or, on a cloud provider's platform, to that provider's storage. When omitted, unchanged. Cannot be null.

transcripts_storage.description: Where copies of the Workspace's transcripts and its cases (Anthropic's safety findings about those transcripts) go once the change takes effect. `external` sends them to the External Storage that `external_storage_id` names. `internal` means no External Storage, so no more copies are made. When omitted, unchanged. Cannot be null.

human_review.description: The Workspace's human review setting. Human review is off only while this is `disabled` and Anthropic's approval stands.

safeguards_storage.description: Where the data Anthropic's safeguards systems retain for the Workspace goes. `external` sends it to the External Storage that `external_storage_id` names. `internal` means no External Storage: it goes to Anthropic's storage or, on a cloud provider's platform, to that provider's storage. A recent change may not have taken effect yet.
safeguards_storage.title: Safeguards Storage

transcripts_storage.description: Where copies of the Workspace's transcripts and its cases (Anthropic's safety findings about those transcripts) go. `external` sends them to the External Storage that `external_storage_id` names. `internal` means no External Storage, so no copies are made.
